pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, sub-polygonal patches with diffuse, smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is heterogeneous, with smaller, more densely packed regions on the upper neck and larger, more spaced regions on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Network of light interstitial corridors characterized by high topological continuity. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-junctions with occasional quad-junctions. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the visible thoracic and cervical regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serration along the neck mane. The silhouette exhibits a continuous, dense textural profile with minimal variation in hair length.

other_distinctive_markers: Two avian subjects (Yellow-billed Oxpeckers) are positioned on the dorsal ridge; one is in mid-landing/flight posture on the posterior shoulder region and the second is perched on the upper rump.
